lines.en: I do not walk, I simply hover.
My body drifts slowly upward.
My scales slide through the clouds.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了整座城。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole town.
My long whiskers hang and sway.
I turn slowly in the air.
Clouds part around my body.
One shift of mine spans miles.
The sky shrinks across my back.
My claws never touch the ground.
I circle the tall tower.
Light trails far behind me.
I coil in the sky, silent.
State your wish.
The Dragon Balls' light clings to me.
I blink and thunder answers.
My breath pushes the clouds apart.
This sky has room for me.
I lower my enormous head.
Golden light moves between my scales.
I look around, no one is near.
Time passes slowly for me.
My tail tip brushes a ridge.
I wait for you to speak.
The wind turns around my horns.
A dragon's silence is the heaviest.

lines.zh: 聚齐了七颗，你才能见我。
lines.en: Only with all seven may you see me.

lines.zh: 你许的愿，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: I hear your wish clearly.
Speak your wish.
I've heard too many wishes.
Your voice trembles.
I will remember your choice.
Little one, you called me here.
There is a whole sky in my eyes.
That isn't what you truly wish?
I will grant it only once.
Make your wish. I am listening.

lines.zh: 你手上还留着龙珠的尘。
lines.en: Dragon Ball dust still clings to your hands.
That was insignificant.
I haven't been hurt in a thousand years.
Your strength hardly matters.
Only a pale streak on my scales.

lines.zh: 龙鳞上只多了一道白印。
lines.en: Only a white mark is left on my scales.
I can't be bothered with that.
A dragon needn't dodge.
You touched one of my scales.
The wound will close on its own.
I am still here.
That I cannot swallow.
I have no need to eat.
You're holding it too low.
Wishes tempt me more than food.
I can catch no scent.
Set it down, I'd rather not look.
Dragons don't eat such things.
If you keep it, eat it yourself.

lines.zh: 我的饥饿要一百年才来。
lines.en: My hunger comes once a century.
Your gesture puzzles me.
You struck my scales.
Don't come too close, it burns.

lines.zh: 我的身体在云上，你碰不到。
lines.en: My body rests on cloud, out of reach.
Did you bounce back?
No space is left beside a dragon.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞激不起我的怒。
lines.en: Such a bump cannot rouse my wrath.
You stepped on my shadow.
Step back, I need the sky.

lines.zh: 你的体积不足以冒犯我。
lines.en: Your size is too small to offend me.
Once is enough.
The age of dragons has passed.
I guard this sky alone.
Such matters don't concern me.
I am not a mortal creature.
Seek that from your own kind.
My mate is light itself.
A thousand years is long, I'm used to it.
Don't say such things, it breaks a wish.
Make your wish, nothing else.
I came only to reclaim the spheres.
I have no need to stoop.
What lies below I leave to you.
I need only the seven spheres.

lines.zh: 这点东西，龙的爪放不下。
lines.en: A dragon's claw can hold nothing so small.
Whatever you dropped is not my concern.
I lift a claw, then set it down.
Gold light slips through my scales.
There is nothing to gather in the sky.
The wind will take your trinket.
I collect only the Dragon Balls.
I have no enemies.
What do you take me for?
I will not fight you.
You cannot bear a dragon's wrath.
I look at you, only this once.
Lower your hand, don't do something foolish.
You would strike a dragon?
My gaze is enough.
I won't strike, and I needn't.
You called me here, not for a brawl.
I lower my head and watch you.
Your courage earns one sigh.
Mortal iron cannot wound me.

lines.zh: 这一界没有东西能伤我。
lines.en: Nothing in this world can harm me.
My shadow follows you still.
Do nothing pointless.
I circle once, you remain.
A dragon's patience is long.

lines.zh: 你手上那点光，我看见了。
lines.en: I see that little light in your hand.
I will not chase you.
Go on, I remain in the sky.
The sky will watch you for me.

lines.zh: 一场雨就能浇灭你的火。
lines.en: One rain will put out your fire.
My eyes are higher than the mountains.
My wish is not yet granted.
If you insist, I still won't move.
I merely came to look.
Be quiet, let me hear it out.
This sky is familiar to me.
My claws only part the clouds.
I lift my tail and sweep the mist.
This motion is not an attack.
The wind pushes me aside.
The shockwave knocks you down.
I did not mean to touch you.
My scales are hard, your hand would break.
I merely turned.
A dragon's tail has weight.
You stand at my shadow's center.
Don't fight beneath my feet.
This is not my battlefield.
I look down and you've stopped.
One thunderclap and you retreat.

lines.zh: 七颗龙珠亮起，天空开了口。
lines.en: The seven spheres shine, the sky opens.
I coil up out of the light.
Storm clouds gather into my shape.

lines.zh: 我的长度盖住了一整片天。
lines.en: My length covers an entire sky.
I am here, speak your wish.
A dragon's cry rolls from the clouds.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，天上多了两颗星。
lines.en: I open my eyes, two stars appear.

lines.zh: 山脊震了下，因为我落了。
lines.en: The ridge shakes because I land.

lines.zh: 我的须先到，我从后面来。
lines.en: My whiskers arrive first, I follow.
Golden light falls like rain.

lines.zh: 凡人的声音把我唤醒了。
lines.en: Mortal voices have woken me.
I coil into a ring, not yet leaving.
The spheres touch down and I appear.
This world's wind remembers me.
Let me see who made the wish.
The sky has come lower.
Fire, to me, is warmth.

lines.zh: 我从天上落下，也毫无损益。
lines.en: I fall from the sky and lose nothing.

lines.zh: 水漫过头顶，我照样呼吸。
lines.en: Water covers my head, I still breathe.

lines.zh: 爆风散开，只动了我的须。
lines.en: The blast only stirs my whiskers.
The arrow shatters on my scales.

lines.zh: 凡人的法，压不住我的光。
lines.en: Mortal magic cannot dim my light.
Hunger has never troubled me.
Lightning is my language.
Even in the void, I can coil.
